system.description:
DISCIPLE MYSTIC STANCE

You adopt the Monkey Stance, a martial technique inspired by the agility and adaptability of monkeys. Whilst in this stance you gain a +2-circumstance bonus to Acrobatics and Climbing checks. Furthermore, you gain a +2-circumstance bonus to all attempts to High Jump or Long Jump (Athletics) and take no penalty for using these actions for 1 AP.

Automated: press Use to enter the stance: 1 AP, under the system's stance rules (one stance at a time, or two with Stance Mastery; Reactive Stance enters it free at initiative). It lasts until you enter another stance or delete its effect. While in it: +2 circumstance to Acrobatics and Climbing checks and to High Jump and Long Jump checks, and a High Jump or Long Jump for 1 AP carries no +2 to its DC (Graham's B6-5).
